Here's a series of semi stylized environments extracted from one simple 3d scene. After so much gritty scifi I really wanted to explore something more peaceful, influenced by Studio Ghibli and Zelda: Breath of the Wild.

Technically my main focus was to test out some new workflows in 3dsmax and Octane as a plugin. Also how to be efficient with overpainting in photoshop and getting rid of a pure 3d look.

-The cloulds are renderable splines with a falloff opacity map.
-All the terrain is put together with just 2 objects which have been squeezed and stretched.
-All the terrain uses one material with tri-planar mapping and no UV-ing, automatically applying the grass and rock material, depending on the normals of the surfaces.
